assets.accepted_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: production 4-by-2 full-object animation source sheet for a Godot children's storybook game
Input image: the immediately preceding image is the exact approved Pearl Castle kettle design and animation-sheet reference. Preserve its seafoam scallop-shell porcelain body, blush-and-cream shell lid, warm-gold handle and hardware, short left-facing spout, separate-but-fixture-attached small shell cup on the left, lavender/navy contours, viewpoint, proportions, palette, polish, and overall 4x2 presentation.

Primary request: redraw the full sheet as exactly eight chronological complete-object states of this same kettle-and-cup fixture in strict reading order: four equal conceptual cells across the top row, then four across the bottom row. Preserve the same normalized mechanics and poses while making every state completely dry.
Eight beats: 1 complete kettle upright at rest, lid seated, handle relaxed, cup empty; 2 actual gold handle lifts; 3 actual spout lever/cap pivots open; 4 kettle begins tilting left toward the fixed attached cup; 5 kettle reaches its greatest coherent pour tilt with the real spout tip aimed directly above the cup center, but there is an obvious clean EMPTY-AIR GAP between spout and cup; 6 kettle returns upright; 7 spout hardware closes and handle lowers; 8 exact complete dry rest. Redraw the entire coherent kettle and cup in every state.

Style/medium: polished pastel 2D children's storybook cel shading in the same Mermaid Roshan Pearl Castle style as the reference; softly hand-painted opaque pearl-shell enamel, mint/aqua porcelain, blush and cream highlights, warm gold joints, lavender/navy edge accents, rounded premium toy-playset geometry.
Composition/framing: same fixed bottom-center fixture pivot and scale across all eight cells; the cup remains fixed at the same left-side footprint and fully visible in every cell; kettle, handle, lid, spout, lever, feet, and cup fully inside each padded conceptual cell. Exactly 4 columns x 2 rows.
Scene/backdrop: one perfectly flat uniform solid #FF00FF chroma-key field across the entire canvas and between conceptual cells, with no panel divisions.

ABSOLUTE DRY-FIXTURE CONSTRAINT: draw NO liquid of any kind in any state. No water inside the kettle, cup, spout, or elsewhere. No stream, trickle, pour ribbon, splash, droplets, beads, mist, steam, foam, bubbles, wet sheen, filled cup, aqua pool, translucent fluid, ripple, or water-colored highlight. The cup interior must be plainly empty dry pearl enamel. State 5 must show only flat-magenta empty air between the spout tip and empty cup so the runtime Jolt-water shader can occupy that gap later.
Other constraints: preserve the actual fixture design and part mechanics; no whole-fixture bounce, generic spin, detached motion marks, arrows, icons, glow, sparkles, hands, characters, extra kettles, extra cups, text, labels, frame numbers, grid lines, borders, room pixels, counter, floor, cast/contact shadows, reflections, scenery, or watermark. No part crosses a cell boundary. Never use #FF00FF inside the subject. Exactly eight complete states.
